fns.desc: tls_init(): on the first-ever call (tls_ref_count==0), 'tls_global = context;' runs at line 413 before wolfSSL_Init() is checked at 415-416; if wolfSSL_Init() < 0, the function returns NULL without freeing context/tls_global and without incrementing tls_ref_count. The tls_context_new()-allocated context is leaked, and tls_global is left pointing at an orphaned, uncounted context (a later successful tls_init() call re-enters the tls_ref_count==0 branch and overwrites tls_global, permanently losing the reference). Not caught by sqc in this batch (no finding at line 416).
